scope: Shared Toolbar, DataTable, Pager, CopyableCode, LookupLoadMore, DetailLine. Preserve search, query cursor, copy feedback, keyboard-scroll, selected lookup and long-value behavior.

spacingOwners.mobile table hint: DataTable; inline inset16 and block-start8; cells remain theme-owned 12×16
spacingOwners.toolbar controls: Toolbar; control gap12 and surface inset16; responsive flow owner remains Toolbar
spacingOwners.lookup load-more row: LookupLoadMore; gap8, inline inset8, preceding gap4
spacingOwners.copy value/control: CopyableCode; inline gap4, long identifiers wrap anywhere
spacingOwners.detail label/value row: DetailLine; inline gap16 and block inset12

uiDesignContract.stateAndInteraction: Search query is trimmed, clear removes q and returns focus, Enter/IME behavior is unchanged, search resets only its configured cursor; Pager preserves unrelated query params and its configured cursor; table retains keyboard horizontal scroll and inner-only overflow; copy feedback remains polite; lookup identity/loading/retry stays intact; detail values may be long and wrap.
uiDesignContract.verification: Run typecheck, 9 checker fixtures plus strict debt report, full verify, then Chromium collection/import/detail checks at 1280×900 and 390×844. Assert measured roles, no document overflow, no page errors, and interact with search/clear/pagination/copy where the route exposes the control. CopyableCode is used on /s/shop-demo/overview (and CommandRecovery); measure its shared row and exercise clipboard feedback on the overview route. Current strict baseline is 473 findings/18 owner areas/24 files; W07 may only remove its owned findings and must not suppress unrelated debt.
uiDesignContract.preservation: Shared components.tsx remains staged by the user at intake; edit only W07-owned component bodies and preserve all staged/unrelated behavior. Do not stage or rewrite the Git index.
